name: verify_provider_auth
description: verify_provider_auth: Authenticate a credentialed provider (physician, nurse, PA) using their NPI, home facility code, and PIN. Returns the provider's first name and employee ID on success, or an authentication failure if the credentials do not match.

npi.description: The provider's NPI number. Format: 10 digits, no letters. Example: 1487392045

facility_code.description: The provider's home facility code. Format: 2-4 uppercase letters, dash, 2 digits, 1 uppercase letter. Example: MGH-04B
